delivery.outcome: Koru recognizes the target-published standard-update diagnostic, launches at most one bounded agent handoff for a separate governance adoption, retries Goal once, and keeps the interrupted commit fail-closed until integration.
nonGoals: Do not trust diagnostics absent from the target-owned catalog
Do not mutate the interrupted implementation ticket into an adoption ticket
Do not grant push, merge, tag or release authority
Do not add more than one agent attempt or Goal retry

architecture.decision: Extend the existing closed remediation allowlist and specialize only the handoff guidance; preserve target-catalog resolution and the one-agent/one-retry execution bound.
architecture.rollback: Remove the standard-update allowlist entry and specialized handoff while retaining GOV-TICKET-001 supervision.

validation.evidence: Focused supervisor behavior plus managed repository gates
